summary: The projectile (bullet) class descriptor, its registry, its Lua field reader chain and the thirteen projectile kinds. The registry 006EA910 maps the Lua Type key to one of thirteen constructors, each of which stores its own sub-type at +8h; that settles the sub-type enum the gun and the impact path switch on. The base reader 006E8770 has 32 keys, cross-checked against the installed arcade bulletclasses.lua. The family splits into two record layouts: MBullet and MFlakBullet keep the shot interface at +170h, and the eight classes under MBomb keep it at +310h. The factory 006E8430 was re-read from the listing for its seven arguments; two of them are never read and two of them were attributed to the wrong record fields in docs/PROJECTILE_IMPACT.md.

routines.name: BSP_BulletClass_GetOrCreate
routines.evidence: Cache singleton 006E9B70 with growth through 006E86F0; Lua globals -> Bullets[id] -> the entry's Type string (00CE4780). Thirteen BSP_NativeString_EqualsCStringInsensitive tests at 006EAAE6..006EACE0 in the order Bullet, Artillery, Kamikaze, Bomb, Torpedo, DepthCharge, DummyTarget, DummyKamikazePlane, DummySubmarine, Paratrooper, Flak, Rocket, WaterMine. Allocation sizes are the ECX constants before the 00470B80 calls: 0D8h bomb (006EAB38), 0FCh torpedo (006EAB68), 0F8h depth charge (006EAB98), 0E4h dummy target (006EABC8), 0E0h dummy kamikaze plane (006EABF8) and dummy submarine (006EAC28), 100h paratrooper (006EAC58), 0DCh flak (006EAC88), 0E8h rocket (006EACB1), 0ECh water mine (006EACDE); Bullet, Artillery and Kamikaze use operator_new(0D4h) at 006EAA62, 006EAAA4 and 006EAAF6. Step 6 calls class->vtable[18h] with the Lua entry, then class[+0Ch] = id.

routines.name: BSP_BulletClass_Construct
routines.evidence: Writes 00CEB130 then 00CFA138, so 00CFA138 is the MBullet vtable and 00CEB130 its ref-counted base. Non-zero defaults: +4h = 1 (ref count), +8h = 1 (sub-type), +54h = 00D7A248, and +5Ch, +88h, +8Ch, +98h, +9Ch = 00D7A24C. 00D7A24C is 1.0f: 006E8493-006E84C9 reuses the same dword for the four diagonal entries of the scale-1 matrix handed to 00923870.

routines.name: BSP_BulletClass_ReadLuaFields
routines.coverage: complete for the key table; the storage-pool release blocks between keys are library code and are not modelled
routines.evidence: Thirty-two keys with their offsets and defaults are tabulated in docs/WEAPON_CLASS_DESCRIPTOR.md. The three fallback chains are at 006E8A0C (ExplLightArmorEfx -> ExplArmorEfx), 006E8A9B (ExplUnderWaterArmorEfx -> ExplArmorEfx) and its successor (ExplDeepUnderWaterArmorEfx -> ExplUnderWaterArmorEfx). Blast is a sub-table whose presence sets the byte at +6Ch; Decals absent stores -1 in +CCh and +D0h. Every key name matches a key in the installed scripts/datatables/classtables/arcade/bulletclasses.lua.

routines.name: BSP_BombClass_ReadLuaFields
routines.evidence: Calls the base reader 006E8770 at 006E1BF9, then reads TimeOutEfx into +D4h. It is the parent of every reader below MBomb.

routines.name: BSP_TorpedoClass_ReadLuaFields
routines.evidence: Calls 006E1BE0 at 008566D7, then MaxWaterHitVel +DCh, MaxFall +E0h, WaterTravelSpeed +E4h, HeadingTurn +E8h, WaterSplashEfx +D8h, HomingHorzTurnSpeed +F0h, HomingVertTurnSpeed +F4h. All seven fit the 0FCh descriptor size.

routines.name: BSP_DepthChargeClass_ReadLuaFields
routines.coverage: partial: the computed +F0h (a LIBCRT_unmatched_00BF7030 result) is unread
routines.evidence: Calls 006E1BE0 at 006FD41B, then MaxWaterHitVel +ECh, MaxFall +F4h, V0RandomFactor +D8h, DiveSpeed +DCh, DiveMinDepth +E0h and DiveMaxDepth +E4h (both defaulting to 00D7A248), WaterSplashEfx +E8h.

routines.name: BSP_RocketClass_ReadLuaFields
routines.evidence: Calls 006E1BE0 at 00809CC6, then VMax (DAT_00D09058) +D8h, Acceleration +DCh, IgnitionDelay +E0h, AntiAir (boolean) +E4h.

routines.name: BSP_FlakBulletClass_ReadLuaFields
routines.evidence: Calls the base reader 006E8770 at 0070C046, not the bomb reader, then clears +D4h and reads the integer MinRange into +58h as a float. Nothing writes the flak fuse time at +D8h that 0070C3E2 reads, and 00470B80 zeroes the allocation.

routines.name: BSP_ProjectileClass_CreateProjectile
routines.abi: __thiscall(classDesc, arg1, ownerId, float* pos, float* dir, char spawnFlag, char nearCamera, int arg7), RET 1Ch at 006E86E2, SEH frame
routines.coverage: complete for the argument handling, record writes, launch velocity and water-entry branch; the stack matrix build and the child-node walk are host contracts
routines.evidence: Frame: PUSH -1 / PUSH 0xc82978 / PUSH EAX, SUB ESP,0x50, PUSH EBX/ESI/EDI, so the return address is at [ESP+68h] and argument n at [ESP+68h+4n]. The only argument slots the body reads are [ESP+70h] at 006E8516 (-> +54h), [ESP+74h] at 006E851D (position), [ESP+78h] at 006E8523 (direction), [ESP+7Ch] at 006E86A0 (-> +278h at 006E86B8) and [ESP+80h] at 006E86A6 (-> +1CCh at 006E86BE). [ESP+6Ch] and [ESP+84h] are never read. The branch at 006E86C4 tests AL, which came from [ESP+7Ch]. The launch bias test at 006E85B4 is the four-way compare against 4, 5, 6 and 7.

routines.name: BSP_FlakBulletClass_CreateProjectile
routines.abi: __thiscall, the same seven stack arguments as 006E8430
routines.coverage: partial: read for the allocation size, the entity constructor and the absence of the launch bias; the tail after 0085DC80 is unread
routines.evidence: operator_new(298h) and memset at 0070CC7x, entity constructor 0070CAE0, the same +174h / +54h / position / +1D0h / +1DCh writes as 006E8430, and a velocity write at 0070CC9x with no sub-type compare because 10h is outside 4..7.

routines.name: BSP_FlakProjectile_Construct
routines.evidence: Calls BSP_ProjectileTickableEntity_Construct, then writes 00CFD5D0 at +0h, 00CFD5B8 at +10h, 00CFD5B0 at +24h, 00CFD570 at +170h (the shot interface) and 00CFD554 at +244h (the tick element), and 32h at +C4h, the class id.

routines.name: BSP_ProjectileShot_SetAirMode
routines.evidence: If the byte at +44h is set, clear it, resume the effect at +24h through 00866B70 and stop the children of the effect at +28h. It is slot 24h of the shot interface vtable 00CF9D90 (the dword at 00CF9DB4).

routines.name: BSP_ProjectileShot_SetWaterMode
routines.evidence: The mirror of 006E6410: if +44h is clear, set it, stop the children of +24h and resume +28h. It is slot 28h of 00CF9D90 (the dword at 00CF9DB8).

routines.name: BSP_LuaBinding_SetTorpedoSwimDepth
routines.evidence: Argument 0 through BSP_LuaTable_GetPtrField gives the entity; argument 1 through BSP_LuaObject_GetNumber gives the depth; the write is *(float*)(entity+47Ch). 47Ch is inside the 51Ch torpedo record and outside the 468h bomb record.

routines.name: BSP_LuaBinding_KillTorpedoesFromUnit
routines.evidence: Walks the world entity registry [00E188A8+19CCh]: head *[registry+8h], next link at node+44h. For each node it calls entity->vtable[5Ch](2Bh) and compares entity[+3BCh] with the handle from argument 0 before BSP_MissionEntity_Kill(2). The same registry is the one 006E8430 registers into at 006E8511.

host_steps.args: PUSH 284h at 006E844B; the memset follows at 006E8462
host_steps.gate: none; a null result is tolerated

host_steps.args: PUSH EAX = &matrix, PUSH EDX = [00E188A8+19CCh], PUSH EBX = 0

host_steps.gate: a Type string matched one of the thirteen names

no_ghidra_function.name: MBullet vtable
no_ghidra_function.evidence: Read from .rdata bytes: 00BD30E0 scalar deleting destructor, 006EA8F0, 006E8400, 006E8410, 006E9890, 006E97F0, 006E8770 (slot 18h, the reader), 006E8420, 006E8430 (slot 20h, the create). The string MBullet follows at 00CFA15C. ghidra xrefs sees only the two writers 006E8333 and 006E9E9F, so the slots had to come from the bytes.

no_ghidra_function.name: MArtilleryBullet vtable
no_ghidra_function.evidence: 00BD30E0, 006EAE80, 006E8400, 006EA1E0, 006E9890, 006E97F0, 006E8770, 006E8420, 006E8430; the name string follows at 00CFA464. Slots 18h and 20h are the base class's, so artillery and bullet share both the reader and the create.

no_ghidra_function.name: MBullet tick element vtable
no_ghidra_function.evidence: 006E7BF0, 006E6750 (place pose), 006E6490 (tick advance), 006E7D50. It is the subobject at projectile+244h that 006E7B00 writes, and the two middle slots are the routines docs/PROJECTILE_IMPACT.md already names.

no_ghidra_function.name: MFlakBullet tick element vtable
no_ghidra_function.evidence: 0070CB70, 006E6750, 0070C370 (the flak tick), 006E7D50. Only the tick differs from MBullet's.

no_ghidra_function.name: MBomb tick element vtable
no_ghidra_function.evidence: 006E2750, 006E1060 (place pose), 006E1300 (tick advance), 006E1010. The depth charge (00CFB9F8) and the rocket (00D09060) repeat the same three tail slots and change only the first; the torpedo (00D0C35C) also changes the fourth to 00855B00.

no_ghidra_function.name: MBullet shot interface vtable
no_ghidra_function.evidence: Slot 20h = 006E2550, slot 24h = 006E6410 (air mode), slot 28h = 006E6450 (water mode), slot 34h = 006E2590, slot 3Ch = 006E6C20. These are the slots 0072BF10 and 006E8430 call on the value the create returns.

corrections.subject: 006e8430 arguments 5 and 6
corrections.was: +1CCh is the gun's spawn flag and +278h the near-camera flag, with vtable[3Ch] firing on the near-camera flag (docs/PROJECTILE_IMPACT.md, the factory's step 9)
corrections.is: +278h takes argument 5, the gun's spawn flag; +1CCh takes argument 6, the near-camera flag; vtable[3Ch] fires on argument 5
corrections.evidence: The frame puts argument n at [ESP+68h+4n]. 006E86A0 reads [ESP+7Ch] (argument 5) into AL and 006E86B8 stores AL at +278h; 006E86A6 reads [ESP+80h] (argument 6) into CL and 006E86BE stores CL at +1CCh. The conditional at 006E86C4 follows CMP AL,BL at 006E86A4, so it tests argument 5. On the caller side 0072BF10 pushes the literal 1 for argument 6 on its near-camera path at 0072BFC5 and the literal 0 at 0072BFE8 on the normal path, while argument 5 comes from 0072BF10's own fourth parameter.

corrections.subject: 006e8430 arguments 1 and 7
corrections.is: arguments 1 and 7 are pushed and never read
corrections.evidence: Filtering the whole 006E8430 listing for ESP-relative reads gives only [ESP+5Ch] (the SEH link), [ESP+64h] (the local sentinel), [ESP+70h], [ESP+74h], [ESP+78h], [ESP+7Ch] and [ESP+80h]. [ESP+6Ch] (argument 1, the literal 0 pushed at 0072C004) and [ESP+84h] (argument 7, gun[+41Ch] pushed at 0072BFE3) never appear. RET 1Ch still pops all seven.

corrections.subject: the sub-type table of docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md step 7
corrections.was: gun[+3F8h][+34h][+8h] selecting 2, 3, 4, 5 or 7, left contract: unread
corrections.is: the gun class descriptor's weapon type gun[+3F4h][+80h], a different enum
corrections.evidence: 007302E4 loads ECX from gun[+3F4h] and 007302EA loads EAX from [ECX+80h], then compares 1, 5 and 6. The projectile sub-type is loaded separately at 0073039D through gun[+3F8h]+34h and compared with 0Ah, 0Bh, 10h and the group 4..7. 007327B0 is the only producer of +80h and stores 0..0Bh from the Function key: 0 none, 1 AAMACHINEGUN, 2 LIGHTARTILLERY, 3 MEDIUMARTILLERY, 4 HEAVYARTILLERY, 5 FLAK, 6 LIGHTARTILLERYFLAK, 7 TORPEDO, 8 DEPTHCHARGE, 9 DEPTHCHARGELAUNCHER, 0Ah BOMBPLATFORM, 0Bh CATAPULT.

corrections.subject: the descriptor's +88h and +8Ch
corrections.was: the projectile class descriptor's rotation rates, read from the Lua stores 00732A30 and 00732A6C (docs/GUN_AIMING.md)
corrections.is: fields of the gun class descriptor gun[+3F4h], written by its own reader 007327B0 from HorzRotSpeed and VertRotSpeed
corrections.evidence: 007327B0 writes [param+88h] at 00732836 and [param+8Ch] at 0073284C, and the same routine writes the weapon type at +80h, which 0072F830 and 00730160 read through gun[+3F4h]. On the projectile class descriptor 006E8770 gives +80h..+8Fh and +90h..+9Fh to the two BSP_GUI_ResolveTextureAndAtlasUV calls at 006E8AFF and 006E8B4E, so the same offsets there are payload-icon atlas rectangles.

corrections.subject: kProjectileClassOffTraceVariant = 0x74 in include/bsp/projectile_impact.hpp
corrections.evidence: 006E89EA: BSP_LuaObject_GetByName(entry, "ExplWaterHit") then BSP_LuaReference_GetBooleanOrDefault(0), stored as a byte at +74h. No other routine writes +74h of this object. The consumer at 0084BF00 was not re-read, so the name is corrected but the header of the other packet is left alone.

corrections.subject: kProjectileClassOffScoringId = 0xCC in include/bsp/projectile_impact.hpp
corrections.is: the Decals.Landscape decal id, -1 when the row has no Decals table; +D0h next to it is Decals.Other
corrections.evidence: 006E8C6D resolves the Landscape string into +CCh and 006E8CD9 the Other string into +D0h; 006E8D0C stores -1 in both when Decals is nil. Provisional: the consumer at 00923A2C was not re-read and may be reading +CCh of a different object.
